package.description: You can easily rename subtitle filenames according to video filenames by using this software.

en-US.description: You can easily rename subtitle filenames according to video filenames by using this software.
en-US.longDescription:
Many Smart-TV's, Home Theater Systems and Media Players require matching subtitle and video filenames. For users having many movies or series with lots of subtitle files, it is a hard work to rename all the subtitle filenames manually. This is where Vovsoft Subtitle Renamer comes in. You can easily rename filenames of closed captions (CC) according to video filenames by selecting the video directory and clicking the "Start" button. The software will rename all the subtitle files.

The software includes "Preview" button to display old and new filenames before starting the actual rename operation. In this way, you can avoid messing up all your subtitle filenames.

You can choose from multiple renaming methods that would work for you:
* All subtitle filenames must match first video
* N-th subtitle filename must match N-th video
en-US.name: Vovsoft Subtitle Renamer
